The research target (12m) moves 427.45 -> 448.69 (+5.0%) with the exit multiple (20.4261x) and every other driver unchanged; opex is recomputed at the booked 15% of revenue. Q1 FY2027 Systems is 9,079 against the CFO's ~8.7B outlook (+4.4%; revenue 11,448 inside the 10,600-11,600 guide, EPS 4.53 inside 4.15-4.55): customers' year-end capex (TSMC's Q4 CY26 budget remainder, Samsung's 2026 plan less YTD) is heavy and the CFO calls Q1 supply-limited, so the gap is flagged, not solved. FY2027-28 revenue 46.9B / 53.4B vs Zacks 45.7B / 54.9B and Morgan Stanley 48.4B / 57.9B. Two lint guide-anchor hits (Q1 revenue and EPS land within 0.3% of midpoint x one past quarter's beat by chance) are overridden with a logged reason. After the citation gate: Q1 gross margin re-run on the mix method (51.01%, +0.4% to the target), the China path re-carded (the 'completing its cycle' quote was the CFO on worldwide digestion, not China), and share-gain, Morgan Stanley logic and UBS TSMC 2028 alternatives added and sized.
